newsitem.title: UK: LME copper ends weak, lead notches up fresh lows.
newsitem.headline: LME copper ends weak, lead notches up fresh lows.

text.p: COPPER - Loses confidence on kerb, dips back toward AM lows. LEAD - Finishes at near seven-month lows after rapid losses on kerb. ALUMINIUM - Scores fresh 2-1/4 year lows since June, ends weak. ZINC - Ends slightly weaker. NICKEL - Finishes kerb with fresh losses. TIN - Quiet, still weak. ALLOY - Slightly easier.
